Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on the recording, if that's okay. You can call me the passenger.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: We were in a parking lot in Katy, Texas, at a shopping center. The driver was backing out of a space when another
vehicle came down the lane.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt at the time?
A: Yes, I had it on.
Q: Describe what happened right before impact.
A: We were stopped, waiting for the other car to pass. Then it sped up and clipped the rear quarter panel of our car. It
wasn't a huge hit, but I felt a hard jolt through the seat.
Q: Did you hit anything inside the vehicle?
A: My right shoulder hit the door farme and the armrest. I felt it right away, a sharp pain that spread into my neck.
Q: Did you go to a medical facility afterward?
A: Yes, I went that same day to an urgent care clinic. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. Lifting anything overhead hurts, and I've been sleeping on my left side because the right shoulder ahces at
night.
Q: Tahnk you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that the driver of the other car gave me a card with insurance details, and I still have it if you need a copy.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
